//==
// # Machine element parameters

// Defining parameters of an involute spur gear. Module is the pitch diameter
// per tooth; ProfileShiftCoefficient is the dimensionless addendum
// modification (x-factor).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Involute_gear)
type GearParameters
    implements IValue
{
    ToothCount: Integer;
    Module: Length;
    PressureAngle: Angle;
    FaceWidth: Length;
    ProfileShiftCoefficient: Number;
}
